svg.text: How the 30 repetitions are scheduled on the 32 vCPUs (same on both instances)
Time runs left to right. Each coloured column is one 60-second repetition; the coloured cells in it are the N workers running AT THE SAME TIME, one per vCPU, lowest vCPU numbers first.
Zoom on one repetition, e.g. Intel c7i.8xlarge, workers=4, repeat=3 (minutes 12-13):
all four start together and run for the same 60 s
30 such rows per instance; the 5 rows of each worker count are averaged into summary.csv.
